name: Reed of Silverfall

primary.name: Oar Sweep
primary.description: Tap for a quick 25-damage oar sweep. Hold up to 1.1s for 40 damage; full charge knocks enemies back and slows struck enemies by 40% for 2s. The moving oar marks the damaging sweep.
primary.ui_brief: Charged oar sweep • 25–40 damage • full charge slows + knockback

secondary.name: Skipping Stones
secondary.description: Throw three skipping stones. Each deals 20 damage, then bounces to one other nearby enemy for 13 damage.

special.name: Silverfall Surge
special.description: A rushing waterfall expands around Reed, dealing 48 damage, pushing enemies away and slowing them for 3 seconds.

passive: River Skipper: each Skipping Stone gains one extra bounce, with reduced damage on each bounce.
lore: A capybara ferryman from Silverfall Reach, guiding lost travelers through the mist.

technique.name: Floodplain
technique.description: Send Silverfall Surge 35% farther, dealing 20% less damage.

final_technique.name: River-Reed Rake
final_technique.description: Sweep three staggered reed arcs; each enemy is hit only once for 23 with a brief slow. Longer reach, slower than the normal melee strike.

attack.name: River-Reed Rake
attack.description: Sweep three staggered reed arcs; each enemy is hit only once for 23 with a brief slow. Longer reach, slower than the normal melee strike.
